environment: Headless Chromium 1234 on local dev server; local 1024px RGBA fixture; actual composeSurface, one face; fresh ImageCache per scenario; no network during measured work
method: PerformanceObserver longtask plus 16ms setInterval heartbeat. Texture init, source decode, per-layer transformation/mask compositing and CanvasTexture creation included; GPU upload/render excluded. One sample each, not a device-independent guarantee.
userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

after.method: Same fixture with setTimeout(0) time slicing. Only task/timer/rAF gaps overlapping the measured window are reported. Actual Playwright click opens the application help dialog during a separate 12-layer build.

schedulerYieldAttempt.method: Same fixture after bounded time slicing; Long Tasks filtered to overlap measured composition window. A cancelled 12-layer high-quality build is tested separately.

fixture.source: local PNG with white/black halves and a transparent left margin; one image reused across layers

limits: These are single samples from a headless browser using software ANGLE; timing and frame cadence vary by device and concurrent host load.
Direct material probes exclude GPU texture upload and 3D draw time. The real-input probe also includes an actual application dialog interaction.
requestAnimationFrameCallbackDelayMs measures a callback opportunity, not completion of GPU rasterization or presentation.
The initial baseline observer collected tasks around setup as well as composition; after-change task/gap lists are filtered to the measured composition window.
The native scheduler.yield attempt did not satisfy timer responsiveness and was replaced. Timer yielding deliberately increases total completion time while allowing interaction between pixel batches.
Frame gaps up to 150 ms were still observed in the final run; these measurements do not establish a guaranteed animation frame rate.
